Year of birth. Age at a visit is approximated as visit year - birth_year.
Female, Male or Other.
Invented locality label (not a real address).
Date registered; always on or before the first appointment.
Dentist identifier, D01-D08.
Invented display name. Any resemblance to a real person is coincidental.
Clinical specialty label used only to make procedure assignment plausible.
Appointment identifier, e.g. A00001 (chronological).

Booked slot (30-minute slots, 10:00-13:30 and 17:00-20:30; closed Sundays and 26 Jan, 15 Aug, 2 Oct).
completed, cancelled or no_show.
Reason recorded when booking (free-text style label).
Treatment line-item identifier, e.g. T00001.
References a COMPLETED appointment. Treatment date = appointment date.
Procedure performed; see the procedure table below for what one row means.
FDI two-digit tooth code (11-48 permanent, 51-85 primary). NULL for non-tooth-specific procedures.

Discount in rupees; never exceeds the listed fee.

Authoritative discount in paise.
